title: Saturating protocols are not constructed (part c constructiveness)

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body: Proposition 'opt' only restates three equality conditions (balanced deterministic feedback; lossless transduction; thermodynamic reversibility) and the Remark gives prose. No concrete protocol (threshold rule, switching schedule, quasi-static limit) is exhibited that provably satisfies all three on the binary flashing ratchet, and their mutual compatibility is not shown — reversibility typically needs slow / quasi-static switching, in tension with extracting $k_BT\log2$ per fast binary decision and with finite power. Part (c) demands identifying the saturating protocols; constructiveness is required. Condition (i) is itself unproved (saturation issue) and the $I_A$ bound rests on the invalid second-law tightening.
